leadText:
Pikachu, Smiling and Fast Asleep (Chinese: 微笑沉睡比卡超 Mèihsiu Chàhmseuih Béikāchīu) is an ending theme of the Cantonese dub of . Despite being made, it has never been used in the dub.

It is an adaptation of 's song "Smiling and Fast Asleep" (Chinese: 微笑沉睡 Mèihsiu Chàhmseuih).
